description: Use action=article with title, url and pasted text to draft a cited adaptation for review; this does not fetch the URL. Inspect its evidence and narration before action=review. Use action=intake with title and notes to organize a pasted document into an editable draft. Review all extracted identities and unassigned lines before action=review. Turn a supplied ordered set list and exact liner notes into a playable story without rewriting them. First use action=review with material, present the returned recordings, narration and issues for approval, then action=prepare with that reviewId after approval. To edit an owned story, action=revise takes sessionId and narration changes, returns a new review, and leaves the original unchanged. Reviews expire after 30 minutes. After preparation, export_video with sessionId and narration beatId creates a short narrated video; video_status with jobId reports progress and signed-in browser download links. Downloads require the same owner to sign in; these links are not public or bearer download URLs. Use credits with sessionId for the saved transcript, source credits, recording identities and owner-only return path. Does not publish or start playback. Music rights are not granted and narration export does not include music.
name: create_authored_story
title: Create from your set list and notes
